summary: T073 pre-paper current-evidence reference repointed from T109 to T112; T112 added to depends_on; T109 retained only as historical read-only predecessor.
rationale: T112 is DELIVERED (APPROVED) and the documented replacement for T109 as the current product-run evidence source per A0026 impact A0026:T073:prepaper-current-evidence. T109's implementation wired cursor-fabricated or coverage-fabricated dataset_partition_refs, a fixed empty event source, block_range values written into tick_range fields and zero-fill run facts; leaving T073's pre-paper authorization bound to the unchanged T109 current-evidence language would let it refer to defective evidence. T112 carries real and resolvable T100 partition references, distinct typed block_range vs tick_range fields, paired-version checksums and the fill-cursor run facts a RunState reader needs. The amendment therefore adds T112 to T073 depends_on, retargets the current-evidence clause in Deliverables, Acceptance, Must-not and References from T109 to T112, and preserves T109 only as a historical read-only predecessor pending the SUPERSEDE amendment. No Must-not, safety, execution, signer, paper-promotion, risk or credential clause is changed. T112 evidence is still consumed without being republished, and absent / mismatched / unavailable / downgraded current evidence still fails closed without authorizing.

impact_assessment.intent: Not applicable. docs/intent/PROJECT_GOALS.md is not edited; G-PAPER-AUTHORIZE-01 and section 7.1 the permission entry rule keep their existing intent. T073 still requires the Owner to complete the three journeys through one bounded Web entry point that writes immutable versioned records.
impact_assessment.specification: Not applicable. T073 references docs/spec/product/WEB_CONSOLE.md (WEB-GLOBAL-003 write-operation grading, WEB-GLOBAL-006 this bounded entry point), docs/intent/PROJECT_GOALS.md (G-PAPER-AUTHORIZE-01, section 7.1 the permission entry rule) and docs/spec/product/ASSET_ADMISSION.md (ADM-PAIR-004 the permission and exposure rules this entry point records); none of these documents are edited by this amendment. A0026 already aligned the relevant spec documents (THREAT_MODEL.md T-21/T-22, DATASET_AND_EVALUATION.md DS-005/DS-006/DS-007) and T112's contract already fixes the paired-version evidence binding and the real-T100-partition resolution.
impact_assessment.contracts: T073 is the only contract edited. Its Dependencies gain T112 alongside the existing T109 edge. Its Deliverables, Acceptance, Must-not and References retarget the current-evidence clause from T109 to T112 manifest and paired simulation-evidence (paired-version checksums). T109 references in the contract are now strictly historical / read-only predecessor language, and pre-T109 T105 / T063 manifests, evidence-unavailable runs and T066 candidate locks remain historical-only. T107, T084, T085, T108, T110, T111, T096, T087, T088, T103 contracts are not in this amendment's target set and remain PLANNED with their existing T109 evidence reference language.
impact_assessment.dependencies: T073 depends_on extends from `T025, T027, T107, T109` to `T025, T027, T107, T109, T112`. T112 is now a hard dependency for the pre-paper authorization contract; the retained T109 edge is the historical read-only path and remains until the SUPERSEDE amendment annotates T109 superseded_by T112. Downstream dependents of T073 (T071, T072, T082, T083, T091, T092, T093, T094, T095, T096) inherit the new current-evidence reference through the existing T073 edges and need no contract edits in this amendment.
impact_assessment.implementation: Not applicable in this amendment. No business code is authored or changed. When T073 is later implemented, the pre-paper Web entry point and authorization gate will consume T112 manifest/evidence per the updated contract. The T109 contract's defective fixed-empty-source and fabricated-reference writer remain non-current for new runs under T112's runtime cutover clause.
impact_assessment.data: Not applicable. Existing T109 manifests, reports and simulation-evidence, pre-T112 T109 records, T105/T069/T063 history, candidate locks and prior pre-paper authorizations stay byte-identical and read-only through the versioned legacy reader. New pre-paper authorizations written after this amendment bind to T112 manifest and paired simulation-evidence with the paired-version checksums the T112 contract defines.
impact_assessment.operations: Not applicable in this amendment. T112's runtime cutover remains gated by T112's atomic-publication clause, and until the reviewed SUPERSEDE amendment annotates T109 superseded_by T112, the cutover boundary keeps new successful production publication disabled. The pre-paper entry point fails closed (no new authorization) until T112 evidence is the only current evidence source available.
impact_assessment.security: Not applicable. T073 grants no signer, paper-live promotion, execution or risk approval; the entry-point boundary already refuses private keys, Keystore passwords, seeds and RPC credentials. T112 evidence carries no private key, signing payload, endpoint secret, webhook credential, .env value, RPC URL or authorization header by contract.
impact_assessment.verification: T073 acceptance retains its existing positive and negative tests and now exercises T112-version rendering: T112 manifest and paired simulation-evidence checksums render in the evidence and candidate views; pre-T112 T109 / T105 / T063 manifests, evidence-unavailable runs and T066 locks render as explicitly historical and non-current; absent, mismatched, unavailable or downgraded current manifest, evidence binding or candidate lock fail closed with the reason recorded; current evidence is consumed without republishing; replay availability and a valid checksum by themselves grant no paper approval; private-key / Keystore / seed / RPC-credential tests remain; the P07 README inspection test still names the same entry point. T112's separate acceptance matrix (real T100 partition resolution, refusal of the fixed empty event source, block_range vs tick_range separation, fill-cursor preservation of position / integer inventory / equity / drawdown / T052 attribution) is exercised by T112, not by T073.

affected_existing_tasks.reason: T073.md asserts that pre-paper authorization binds to the current T109 manifest/report/simulation-evidence checksums and that T109 is the registry-bound current evidence source. After T112 is APPROVED, T109 is the documented predecessor with cursor-fabricated partition refs, block_as_tick evidence and zero-fill run facts; trusting T109 as current in T073 would let the pre-paper authorization refer to defective evidence. A reader of T073's contract that relies on the unchanged language would be misled into treating the defective T109 evidence as the current basis for authorization.
affected_existing_tasks.required_disposition: CONTRACT: deliverables, acceptance, must-not and references retarget current-evidence language from T109 to T112 manifest and paired simulation-evidence (paired-version checksums); T109 is preserved only as historical read-only predecessor pending the SUPERSEDE amendment; no Must-not, safety, execution or signer clause is weakened. DEPENDENCY: T112 added to T073 depends_on (`T025, T027, T107, T109, T112`). IMPLEMENTATION: not applicable in this amendment; the pre-paper Web entry point will consume T112 evidence when the contract is later executed. DATA: existing T109 / T105 / T069 / T063 artifacts and prior pre-paper authorizations stay byte-identical and read-only. OPERATIONS: not applicable in this amendment; runtime cutover remains gated by T112 and the SUPERSEDE amendment. SECURITY: not applicable; the entry-point credential boundary is unchanged and T112 evidence carries no secrets. VERIFICATION: existing acceptance clauses remain plus T112-version rendering, pre-T112-legacy rendering, fail-closed current-evidence cases, no-republication, replay-does-not-approve and credential-refusal tests; the P07 README inspection test still names the same entry point.
